description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal plugin class 'MediaLibrarySelectForm' for rendering and handling a media selection form within the Drupal media library module. It includes methods for form rendering, validation, and AJAX handling related to media selection.

classes.name: MediaLibrarySelectForm
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a form for selecting media items within the media library, including rendering, validation, and AJAX response handling.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns a placeholder HTML comment with form item ID and media ID.

methods.name: form_element_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the form element.

methods.name: form_element_row_id
methods.description: Retrieves the media entity ID from a views result row.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form output as pipeline markup.

methods.name: viewsForm
methods.description: Builds the media library selection form with checkboxes, AJAX setup, and submit button.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.description: Handles AJAX submission, updates media selection, and enforces slot limits.

methods.name: viewsFormValidate
methods.description: Validates that at least one media item is selected.

methods.name: clickSortable
methods.description: Indicates whether the form is sortable; returns false.
